t: A life-size humanoid robot you 3D print and build from free plans.
steps: Read the build guides on the official InMoov site and pick the Finger Starter as your first part.
Get access to a 3D printer with a bed of at least 12 by 12 by 12 centimeters.
Download the free STL files from the InMoov parts viewer and print them in PLA or ABS.
Buy the electronics from the hardware map, starting with an Arduino Uno and one servo.
Install the Arduino IDE and MyRobotLab on your computer.
Flash the MRLComm firmware to the Arduino and move the finger from MyRobotLab.
Grow the build to the hand, forearm, arm, and head one guide at a time.
Buy more servos, Arduino Megas, Nervo Boards, and a strong 6 volt power supply as the robot grows.
